en: Colorized view from a path on a hillside looking toward a historic walled city with many trees in the foreground. Several medieval stone towers with red roofs and a tall church spire dominate the skyline, together with a round tower complex and a domed church with an onion-shaped cupola. The sky is lightly clouded with a soft gradient from pink near the horizon to blue above. No printed text is visible on the image side.
